fato_historico: 1736: Following the Porteous Riots, a mob storms the Tolbooth prison in Edinburgh and lynches John Porteous.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle tide pulling you toward introspection and emotional healing. Much like the way stories of old remind us that justice and mercy must dance together, you may find it is a good time to release heavy burdens. Consider clearing your mental space to welcome fresh, serene possibilities that align with your true self.
frase_do_dia: Still waters run deep with the magic of your own intuition.
significado_numero: A lucky number representing the awakening of your spiritual potential today.
conselho: Trust your inner voice and let go of what no longer serves you.
